codes.description: codeprobe could not resolve a narrative source: the repo has no merged PR narratives discoverable via gh, or the detected host is not GitHub (PR/MR narrative fetch is GitHub-only via the gh CLI).
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass --narrative-source explicitly. Accepted names: pr, commits, rfcs (e.g. --narrative-source commits).

codes.description: Two mutually exclusive CLI flags were supplied on the same invocation.
codes.remediation_pattern: Remove one of the conflicting flags and retry.

codes.description: An operation that requires Sourcegraph authentication was invoked without a valid token (for example, --backend sourcegraph).
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe auth sourcegraph` to authenticate, or pick a different backend (e.g. --backend ast for tool-independent ground truth).

codes.description: Trace capture exceeded the configured overflow threshold and was truncated.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run with --trace-max-bytes=<higher> or --trace-disable to avoid truncation.

codes.description: No experiment was found matching the current working directory or the user's selection history.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe experiment list` and `codeprobe experiment new` to establish an experiment.

codes.description: Multiple experiments match the current selection; codeprobe needs disambiguation.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass --experiment=<id> with the exact experiment id from `codeprobe experiment list`.

codes.description: The selected experiment or suite contains no runnable tasks.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe experiment show` to inspect task inclusion rules, or mine/scaffold new tasks.

codes.description: The provided suite filter did not match any known suites.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe suite list` to see available suites and re-issue with a valid name.

codes.description: The provided --permission-mode value is not one of the accepted modes.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass --permission-mode=<readonly|workspace|full> (see `codeprobe run --help`).

codes.description: The run was interrupted by the user (SIGINT/SIGTERM) before completion.
codes.remediation_pattern: Inspect partial results under .codeprobe/runs/<run-id> and re-run if desired.

codes.description: Per-task trace budget was exceeded; the task's trace was capped.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run with --trace-budget=<higher> or --no-trace to skip trace capture.

codes.description: Exporting source artifacts requires explicit acknowledgement of the data egress implications.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run with --acknowledge-source-export to confirm intent.

codes.description: The supplied evidence-export approval digest does not match the current five-artifact preview.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe snapshot evidence preview REQUEST`, review every artifact, and pass the exact printed digest to `codeprobe snapshot evidence export`.

codes.description: A received zero-code-access evidence directory could not be proven to contain an intact, schema-valid, approval-bound five-artifact bundle.
codes.remediation_pattern: Do not repair or supplement the received directory. Ask the data owner to resolve the local request, approve a new export, send the final preview digest through the agreed authenticated channel, and rerun `codeprobe snapshot evidence validate BUNDLE --expect TRUSTED_DIGEST`.

codes.description: The canary task failed its proof-of-work check, indicating an unreliable run environment.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor` and inspect canary artifacts under .codeprobe/runs/<run-id>/canary.

codes.description: Canary proof-of-work is required for this run configuration but was not enabled.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run with --canary-proof to enable canary verification.

codes.description: The canary result did not match the expected reference output.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor` and compare canary diff output to identify environment drift.

codes.description: The canary gate blocked the run because canary metrics fell outside acceptance bounds.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor --canary` to review gate thresholds and canary deltas.

codes.description: Snapshot creation failed (disk, permissions, or git state).
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor` to diagnose the snapshot backend and retry after resolving the underlying issue.

codes.description: Snapshot integrity verification failed; the snapshot is corrupt or has drifted.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe snapshot verify --verbose` and rebuild the snapshot if necessary.

codes.description: A legacy hashes-only snapshot contains copied file bodies and cannot satisfy the hardened no-source snapshot contract.
codes.remediation_pattern: Recreate the snapshot from the original experiment with the installed CodeProbe version, verify the new directory, and do not share the legacy directory.

codes.description: Required metadata fields are missing from a task, run, or snapshot record.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe validate` on the affected artifact to identify missing fields.

codes.description: Metadata is present but violates schema (wrong type, out-of-range value, or malformed reference).
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe validate --strict` and repair the offending fields.

codes.description: Detected drift between recorded agent capability profile and current environment.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor --capabilities` to view drift details and re-baseline if intentional.

codes.description: The requested backend identifier does not match any registered codeprobe backend.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass --backend=<one of: claude|codex|copilot|...> — see `codeprobe run --help` for the current registry.

codes.description: An experiment arm requests knobs (mcp_config, allowed/disallowed tools, max_turns, permission_mode) its agent adapter cannot honor; running would silently drop them and the arms would not be comparable. Refused pre-spend, no override flag.
codes.remediation_pattern: Set agent=claude for the arm, or remove the unsupported knobs from the config. For MCP arms on tool-surface-less adapters, mcp_mode=loose runs with a comparison-validity warning.

codes.description: An arm requests a quarantined adapter (currently codex): a single-shot completion API that never sees the repository and cannot edit files, so its scores are not comparable. Refused upfront, before any arm runs or spends; no override flag.
codes.remediation_pattern: Set --agent claude (first-class) or copilot for the arm. Quarantine lifts when the adapter is rewritten around the real OpenAI Codex CLI agent.

codes.description: No agent backends are configured or discoverable in this environment.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor` to see which backends were probed and install at least one.

codes.description: Offline preflight checks failed — required cached artifacts or local binaries are unavailable.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor --offline` to list missing prerequisites before retrying.

codes.description: The supplied repository URL could not be parsed as a valid git URL.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass --repo=<https://host/owner/name.git or git@host:owner/name.git> with a well-formed URL.

codes.description: git clone failed (network, auth, or server-side error).
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor --net` and verify git credentials and connectivity before retrying.

codes.description: Calibration results were rejected because they fell outside acceptance bounds or statistical power thresholds.
codes.remediation_pattern: Inspect `codeprobe calibrate report` and increase sample size or adjust thresholds as appropriate.

codes.description: One or more `codeprobe doctor` checks failed.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor --verbose` to view per-check failure details.

codes.description: The run exceeded its configured cost/time budget. This error is intentionally diagnostic (not prescriptive): auto-retrying with a higher budget is unsafe and must be an explicit human decision.
codes.remediation_pattern: Review the run's cost report and, if intentional, re-run with an explicitly increased --budget — but only after confirming the previous run's behaviour.

codes.description: codeprobe could not infer a goal or intent for mining from the repository signals available.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe mine --goals` with an explicit goal specification, or supply --goal=<description>.

codes.description: Sourcegraph-backed discovery exceeded the configured request or token quota.
codes.remediation_pattern: Inspect `codeprobe doctor --sg` output and wait for quota reset or reduce discovery scope.

codes.description: A component attempted network IO while codeprobe was running in --offline mode.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor --offline` to identify the component and either pre-cache its data or drop --offline.

codes.description: Running in CI requires an explicit tenant binding; codeprobe refuses to infer one.
codes.remediation_pattern: Set the CODEPROBE_TENANT environment variable (or `--tenant=<id>`) in your CI configuration.

codes.description: The user-home skill bundle referenced by this run is older than the currently installed codeprobe version.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor --skills` and re-install the referenced skill bundle to refresh it.

codes.description: The configured LLM provider is unavailable (auth, rate limit, or outage). Usually surfaced as a warning rather than a hard stop.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe doctor --llm` and verify provider credentials and status.

codes.description: Another codeprobe process holds the tenant lock for the same command (mine/run/snapshot). Only one such invocation may run per tenant at a time.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `ps -p <holder_pid>` to inspect the live holder, or remove the stale lockfile at ~/.codeprobe/state/{tenant}/.lock-<command> if you are sure the holder is dead.

codes.description: The Class E fairness scan found one or more oracle paths or symbols leaking into agent-facing files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, README, .cursor/rules) or rendered preambles. Agents reading those files would receive an unfair hint about the answer.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe snapshot fairness <task_root> --report fairness.json` to inspect the leaks, then either redact the offending agent-facing file or remove the leaking task from the corpus before retrying.

codes.description: `codeprobe explore` was run with no RUN_DIR and no run directory (a per_trial.json file or per-arm <arm>/results.json dirs) was found under ./runs.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass a run directory explicitly: codeprobe explore runs/<id> (optionally with --serve --port 8766).

codes.description: The infra-failure validity gate FAILED: the run still holds unresolved infrastructure casualties (quota/OAuth exhaustion, rate limit, output-token-ceiling overrun, network timeout, crash), whose 0.0 scores are not solution-quality measurements. The run is NOT quotable — its mean, ranking, and comparisons are biased toward zero. The report is still rendered; only the exit code says so. Offending trial ids are listed in `error.detail.infra_failure_trial_ids`.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run the listed infra-failure trials to 'completed' (or reclassify them genuine with a reason), then re-run `codeprobe interpret <experiment>`.

codes.description: An artifact_eval/dual-scored task is missing tests/ground_truth.json (and the legacy task-root ground_truth.json), so ArtifactScorer would score it verifier_error instead of a real result — typically a stale or interrupted `codeprobe mine` run.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-mine the repo to regenerate the oracle: `codeprobe mine <path> --dual-verify`.

codes.description: A task declares a weighted checkpoint whose tests/verifiers script is missing, unreadable, unsafe, empty, comment-only, or the historical exit-0 full-credit stub.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-mine the task to regenerate its checkpoint verifier scripts: `codeprobe mine <path>`.

codes.description: The target checkout has uncommitted changes (tracked modification, staged change, or untracked file outside codeprobe-owned dirs). Trial worktrees are created from HEAD, so uncommitted changes would be excluded from every trial and the eval would measure a tree the user is not looking at.
codes.remediation_pattern: Commit or stash the changes, or re-run with `--allow-dirty` to accept that agents only see HEAD.

codes.description: The run path does not resolve to a git work tree, so worktree isolation cannot function.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run codeprobe from inside a git repository: clone the repo, or `git init` and commit, then retry.

codes.description: codeprobe run was invoked outside a detected container without explicit consent. A run executes an autonomous agent with --dangerously-skip-permissions plus mined third-party test/verifier scripts directly on this machine, with the invoking user's full filesystem, credential, and network access.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run inside a container (or set CODEPROBE_SANDBOX=1 yourself if your containment is not auto-detected), or re-run with `--uncontained` to accept host execution.

codes.description: The provided experiment name or config label is not a safe path component (must start with a letter or digit and contain only letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, and dots).
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run with --name=<safe-name> (or --label=<safe-label>) using only letters, digits, hyphens, underscores, and dots.

codes.description: `codeprobe experiment init` found an existing experiment at the target location and refuses to overwrite it.
codes.remediation_pattern: Run `codeprobe experiment status <path>` to inspect the existing experiment, or init with a different --name or target path.

codes.description: experiment.json exists at the resolved location but could not be loaded (corrupt JSON or schema violation).
codes.remediation_pattern: Inspect <experiment_dir>/experiment.json and repair it, or re-run `codeprobe experiment init` in a fresh location.

codes.description: `codeprobe experiment add-config` was given a --label that already exists in the experiment.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run with a distinct --label=<new-label>.

codes.description: `codeprobe experiment update-config` or `remove-config` was given a --label that does not exist in the resolved experiment.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run with an existing --label from `codeprobe experiment status <path>`.

codes.description: `codeprobe experiment update-config` was invoked without any option that changes the selected configuration.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass at least one field option such as --new-label, --agent, --model, --mcp-config, --allowed-tools, or --hide-local-source.

codes.description: `codeprobe experiment update-config --new-label` refused to move run artifacts because the destination runs/<label> path already exists.
codes.remediation_pattern: Inspect the reported run directory, move or purge the stale artifacts intentionally, then retry the config rename.

codes.description: --mcp-config was neither an inline JSON object string nor a path to a readable JSON file.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass --mcp-config=<path-to-mcp.json> or an inline JSON object string.

codes.description: `codeprobe experiment init` requires --name in interactive mode.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass --name=<experiment-name>, or --non-interactive to use the default name.

codes.description: `codeprobe probe` extracted no probeable symbols (functions, classes, methods) from the repository, so no probe tasks could be generated.
codes.remediation_pattern: Confirm the repo contains Python or TypeScript source; if --lang was passed, drop it to scan all supported languages.

codes.description: `codeprobe experiment aggregate` needs at least one configuration with results to aggregate.
codes.remediation_pattern: Add a configuration with `codeprobe experiment add-config <path> --label <label>`, run it, then re-aggregate.

codes.description: The repository's primary language is outside the supported mining matrix — Python, Go, and JavaScript/TypeScript — or comprehension mining (Python-only import-graph analysis) was requested on a non-Python repository. Other languages produce zero tasks because test-command generation exists only for the supported matrix.
codes.remediation_pattern: Mine a Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript repository. For comprehension mining on a Go or JS/TS repo, use --goal quality instead.

codes.description: MCP-family mining could not derive the Sourcegraph repo identifier from the repository's origin remote (missing or not a parsable GitHub URL). An empty --sg-repo silently disables the Sourcegraph consensus leg and a wrong value corrupts the MCP-benefit comparison, so codeprobe refuses instead of degrading.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass --sg-repo github.com/{owner}/{repo} matching the repository's Sourcegraph identifier.

codes.description: `codeprobe skills install` found existing SKILL.md files at the destination that differ from the packaged versions. Nothing was written — overwriting local edits requires explicit consent. The conflicting skill names are listed in `error.detail.conflicts`.
codes.remediation_pattern: Re-run with --force to overwrite the listed skills, or move the locally edited copies aside first.

codes.description: `codeprobe purge --yes` found a deletion candidate that resolves outside <PATH>/.codeprobe/ (typically a symlink inside a runs/ tree pointing at customer source). The purge aborted before deleting anything (fail closed). The refused paths are listed in `error.detail.refused`.
codes.remediation_pattern: Inspect the listed paths (`ls -la <path>`), remove the escaping symlink manually, then re-run `codeprobe purge <path> --yes`.

codes.description: The --out path passed to `mine`, `run`, or `interpret` has a parent directory that does not exist or is not writable.
codes.remediation_pattern: Pass a --out path whose parent directory already exists and is writable (mkdir -p it first if needed).

codes.description: An artifact_eval/dual-scored task has a ground_truth.json that exists but cannot be used as an oracle — a directory, oversized, invalid JSON, a non-object, or a schema no scorer can dispatch (e.g. an unknown answer_type or an empty expected set). Every trial would score verifier_error, so the run is rejected before any adapter is spawned rather than after burning the trial budget.
codes.remediation_pattern: Inspect the reported tasks with `codeprobe validate <path> --json`, then re-mine to regenerate the oracle: `codeprobe mine <path> --dual-verify`.

codes.description: `codeprobe bootstrap` could not prepare both digest-verified containment images. The existing prepared-image identity record was left unchanged.
codes.remediation_pattern: Inspect `codeprobe bootstrap --help`, verify the image references, expected digests, engine access, and optional OCI archives, then retry.
